name: Brawlers 👊
desc:
Shoot. Fight. Own the streets and da hood.

Buy weapons, complete missions, rob ATMs and registers, tase people, fight baddies, form gangs, and become the most powerful gangster.

Controls:
- F to grab people and chokehold them.
- G to carry people and throw them.
- E to stomp people and finish them.
- C to crouch.
- SHIFT to sprint.

IF YOU LEAVE DURING COMBAT YOU WILL LOSE YOUR WEAPONS AND AMMO.
THIS IS A HARD GAME.
